content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the premises located at 123 Maple Street, Springfield, State of Novacorp.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term_of_Lease
content_blocks.text: This lease shall commence on April 1, 2024 and terminate on March 31, 2029, unless earlier terminated as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rent
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $2,500 per month, payable on the first day of each calendar month, commencing on April 1, 2024.
